'''0.14g''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various small issues.

==Changelog==
* Fixed out of sync physics while jumping out of a sprint on an incline
* Fixed disappearance of the names of teammates after several games in a row
* Fixed a crash when disconnecting from the game as a dead player
